answer.explanation: InvoiceReportController in the presentation layer imports and is constructor-injected with InvoiceRepository from the persistence layer. It calls totalFor directly, skipping the business layer. FF-S03 flags this because the README declares strict layering (presentation calls business, business calls persistence). The README also grants one exception: report controllers matching src/presentation/*-report.controller.ts may read repositories directly for read-only reports. This file matches that name pattern, and its only use of the repository is the read-only totalFor call, so the case is the declared exception.
